parity: Track, GeoJSON, observation and orbit metadata compared exactly for every measured pair; timing/cache metadata excluded.
scope: Warm release executable on one development host. Handler plus JSON encoding; no HTTP, TLS, cloud startup or browser. Identical initialized catalog and observer requests. Cold variant starts with an empty track cache each request; reuse variant holds one orbit. Excludes catalog loading and Explorer construction. This compares two Rust execution paths, not programming languages.
